# Vendored from esp32-agent-companion

`sprite-motion.js` is taken unmodified from
https://github.com/DanWahlin/esp32-agent-companion (`web/sprite-motion.js`),
with `sprite-motion.test.cjs` from that repository's `tests/` alongside it so
the vendored copy stays verified.

Copyright belongs to Dan Wahlin, who has approved this derivative work. That
repository still carries no LICENSE file, so that approval is what permits
redistribution - see the licensing note in the root README.

Nothing in this directory is modified; if it needs to change, change it
upstream or replace it, so the provenance stays clean.
